description: Source code for the Webhook store implementation in Mattermost, managing incoming and outgoing webhooks with database operations.

classes.name: SqlWebhookStore
classes.description: Struct implementing webhook storage operations, including database queries for incoming and outgoing webhooks.

methods.name: ClearCaches
methods.description: Clears internal caches related to webhooks (no implementation).

methods.name: newSqlWebhookStore
methods.description: Constructor function initializing the webhook store with query builders for incoming and outgoing webhooks.

methods.name: InvalidateWebhookCache
methods.description: Invalidates webhook cache by ID (no implementation).

methods.name: SaveIncoming
methods.description: Saves a new incoming webhook to the database after validation.

methods.name: UpdateIncoming
methods.description: Updates an existing incoming webhook in the database.

methods.name: GetIncoming
methods.description: Retrieves an incoming webhook by ID.

methods.name: DeleteIncoming
methods.description: Marks an incoming webhook as deleted by setting DeleteAt timestamp.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteIncomingByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes incoming webhooks associated with a user.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteIncomingByChannel
methods.description: Permanently deletes incoming webhooks associated with a channel.

methods.name: GetIncomingList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of incoming webhooks with pagination.

methods.name: GetIncomingListByUser
methods.description: Retrieves incoming webhooks filtered by user ID with pagination.

methods.name: GetIncomingByTeamByUser
methods.description: Retrieves incoming webhooks filtered by team and user.

methods.name: GetIncomingByTeam
methods.description: Retrieves incoming webhooks by team.

methods.name: GetIncomingByChannel
methods.description: Retrieves incoming webhooks by channel.

methods.name: SaveOutgoing
methods.description: Saves a new outgoing webhook to the database after validation.

methods.name: GetOutgoing
methods.description: Retrieves an outgoing webhook by ID.

methods.name: GetOutgoingListByUser
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks filtered by user ID.

methods.name: GetOutgoingList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of outgoing webhooks.

methods.name: GetOutgoingByChannelByUser
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks filtered by channel and user.

methods.name: GetOutgoingByChannel
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks by channel.

methods.name: GetOutgoingByTeamByUser
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks filtered by team and user.

methods.name: GetOutgoingByTeam
methods.description: Retrieves outgoing webhooks by team.

methods.name: DeleteOutgoing
methods.description: Marks an outgoing webhook as deleted.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteOutgoingByUser
methods.description: Permanently deletes outgoing webhooks by user.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteOutgoingByChannel
methods.description: Permanently deletes outgoing webhooks by channel.

methods.name: UpdateOutgoing
methods.description: Updates an existing outgoing webhook.

methods.name: AnalyticsIncomingCount
methods.description: Returns count of incoming webhooks, filtered by team and user.

methods.name: AnalyticsOutgoingCount
methods.description: Returns count of outgoing webhooks, filtered by team.
